changes.title: Bedroom smooth
items: The bedroom no longer freezes for a second or more at a time while the island loads: her animations, the fairy lights and the wake-up's alarm keep moving

changes.title: Packs moves
items: Animals keep their own moves when they fight as a pack: boars charge, toads leap, moles burrow up under you, wild bats and ravens dive from the air, bats screech, snails leave their slime and wolves circle round you
A boar stampede now comes at you one boar at a time, so each charge can be dodged

changes.title: Packs fixes
items: A hurt animal on its own (or a pack that's all hurt) fights on instead of hanging back for ever, so fights between animals end and a beaten one is knocked down
Packs strike at you one at a time, as single animals do, so every attack can be dodged, even a wolf pack's howl
Animals attacking a soundsystem or speaker hit it as hard as before packs, without stopping to back off
